clinicalSources.title: CDC — Clinical guidelines for post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis

caption: A timeline separates the antecedent streptococcal infection from delayed immune-mediated nephritic findings.
question: Why can nephritic symptoms appear after a streptococcal infection has settled?
answer: PSGN is a delayed immune-mediated process, typically after a latent interval rather than a direct bacterial infection of the kidneys.
